references.text: This is the original instruction from God to Moses to make six planks for the back of the tabernacle facing west. Exodus 36:27 describes the execution of this command.
The entire passage gives detailed instructions for the tabernacle's planks, including their number, placement, and construction, which are carried out in Exodus 36.
The broader context for building the tabernacle's planks, where verse 27 is part of the complete description of the work to erect the tabernacle's framework.
Complementary instruction on the corner construction of the same wall.
Complementary description of the crossbars that hold the west wall together.
